narrNote: MCRSP appears as Missouri's affiliate on NARR's official affiliates page (narronline.org/affiliates, fetched in-run, HTTP 200); corroborated by the Fletcher Group Missouri state page, which lists 'NARR Affiliate Status: Yes, Missouri Coalition of Recovery Support Providers (MCRSP)'. mcrsp.org fetched HTTP 200 with matching content.
notes: Agency is Missouri's SAMHSA Single State Agency (Department of Mental Health); the linked Division of Behavioral Health page was fetched HTTP 200 in-run ('Behavioral Health – Substance Use and Mental Illness'). Agency phone is null: no published main line was confirmed on the DMH pages fetched in-run, so none is listed rather than publishing an unverified number. Missouri Credentialing Board certifies Missouri peer specialists (CPS/CRPR credentials) and operates mopeerspecialist.com; MCRSP is a peer/recovery-community provider coalition and Missouri's NARR affiliate. medicaidSud points to the MO HealthNet Division (Missouri Medicaid, which covers SUD treatment incl. the CSTAR program); an older DSS opioid-crisis page now redirects off-domain (to time2actmissouri.com), so the stable MO HealthNet Division page was used instead. Every URL in this file was fetched on 2026-10-22 and returned HTTP 200 with matching content. Read-only public research only: no logins, no credentials, no form submissions, no downloads.
